title: Localized languages
slide_intent: Teach designers to preserve typographic hierarchy across scripts and translated text lengths. Equal nominal sizes can give letters different apparent sizes and lines different lengths.
strategic_value: Slack can carry a recognizable editorial hierarchy across languages while choosing fonts suited to each script and channel.
demonstration: Guidance for Japanese and four European languages sits beside three versions of an Intuit customer story. The English example with an image occupies the top, with Spanish and Japanese beneath.
practical_value: Compare line fit and apparent size in translation. The 2020 page specifies a 15% reduction for Japanese and 10% for Portuguese, Spanish, French and German relative to English.

content_islands.spec: Separate Japanese font and size guidance from the second group of languages. Keep the language labels bold in the left column.
